placements.why: The content specifies pipeline behavior as a deontic mandate — what the system must do (produce a slug, commit the file) and through which mechanisms (LLM id-gen call, deterministic slugify fallback). This names an organizational category for system design and behavior that nothing in the existing strata or structure covers.
placements.title: system behavior specified as load-bearing mandates
placements.frame: What must the system do, and through which mechanisms?

placements.title: identity generated from content when none is supplied at submission
placements.frame: What must the pipeline do to produce identity when a submission arrives without one?
placements.why: src-1 states the triggering condition — a memory submitted without an explicit id field — as a settled, unhedged fact. src-2 states the operational mandate that answers it: the pipeline must produce a slug from memory content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback and commit successfully. Together they name a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the pipeline's identity-generation behavior when identity is absent — which passes the grain test: it is true beyond the words it describes, not a one-time measurement or event.
